risk_note: F1-08al (D10-1994 (一), D10-1998). Withdrawal review list: with payout.manual_entry, APPROVED rows can be ticked and 【批量手动打款】 opens a dialog where each row takes channel serial, paid time and paid amount; one POST /admin/v1/withdrawals/batch-manual-paid (Idempotency-Key + totp step-up), per-item results shown as they are, partial success never reported as full. Paid amount: empty on open, no default / prefill / shortcut of any kind, never rewritten; format /^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/ on the trimmed text, then yuanStrToFen must equal net_fen (fixes the 98.009 truncation S2). Result-unknown handling as F1-08ce. Frozen [AC-F1-08ai-ACCESS#1] changed by modify_existing (rule_change, D10-1994): the manual_entry holder now has checkboxes exactly on APPROVED rows. Known open S2: a 10403 on retry after an unknown result unlocks the dialog (FU-F108AL-UNKNOWN-RETRY-10403, together with useAdjustmentWrite). Rule tests: round 1 Codex, rounds 2-3 independent Claude; spec-test by independent Claude; money review by independent Claude (Codex out of quota, D10-2003). Implementation by Opus 5.5. Written by hand.

reviews.note: Independent Claude via tools/agent/claude-run.sh (approvals #36, D10-2003: Codex usage limit until 2026-11-23). Round 1 ran twice: the first output (pass + S2 on 98.009 truncation) was refused by the wrapper because one checklist citation lay outside the diff hunks; the S2 was fixed and the rerun passed with one S2 left open by orchestrator ruling D10-2035 (FU-F108AL-UNKNOWN-RETRY-10403). couli-runs/F1-08al/review-claude-money-r1.json

spec_test_review.note: tests: round 1 by Codex (codex-run.sh), rounds 2-3 by independent Claude contexts (claude-run.sh, ledger tester claude-independent after Codex usage limit, #271 / D10-2003); round 3 and the third spec-test per ops/approvals.yaml #103; input samples of VALIDATE#3 added and adjusted afterwards per D10-2025 / D10-2027 on the non-implementer side. spec-test r1 fail, r2 pass, r3 pass, each by a fresh independent Claude
